name: Managed Rotational Grazing
description: Moving livestock between pastures to allow forage recovery and stimulate root growth.

name: Biochar Application
description: Adding stable, carbon-rich charcoal to soil to improve fertility and lock carbon for centuries.

name: Compost Application
description: Applying organic waste to soil to increase microbial activity and organic carbon stock.

name: No-Till Farming
description: Eliminating tillage to prevent soil erosion and keep carbon trapped in the ground.

name: Agroforestry
description: Planting rows of trees among crops to increase total biomass per hectare.

name: Silvopasture
description: Integrating trees into livestock grazing areas to enhance biodiversity and biomass carbon.

name: Cover Cropping
description: Planting non-harvested crops to protect and enrich soil during off-seasons.
